name: reviewable-artifacts-mcp

tools.name: get_setup_instructions
tools.description: Explains the credential needed to connect this MCP without exposing any review data. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

instructions: Reviewable is installed but cannot read review data yet. Ask the user to configure access locally in their MCP host, then reconnect. Never paste a credential, workspace key, or reviewer link into chat.
